project: FLAME-conditioned Avatar Forcing: region-masking ablations, then a latent emotion split of the audio-driven model
project_note: Every ablation branches from one shared 25k-step trunk (landmark-only, no masks) and trains with a masked-consistency loss: each sample also runs with part of the FLAME condition removed. Evaluation: HDTF-50 at the Avatar Forcing crop, in three modes (full FLAME, FLAME without mouth + jaw, audio only). Latent split: an audio-only student of ablation 2 @100k whose block-4 features split into a neutral (speech) part and an emotion part, then a VA -> latent model that sets the emotion from valence / arousal. 50k steps per run.

runs.name: both_nadv
runs.title: Latent split: both, neutral-target adversarial
runs.description: Adversarial network with a neutral-VA target (it learns the real VA from h_neu; the student is pulled so the network reads h_neu as neutral), weight 0.1, plus the neutral-FLAME pull (cosine + L2). The method (full student).

runs.name: va_both_nadv
runs.title: Latent split: VA -> latent on both (neutral-target)
runs.description: VA -> latent model on the frozen both_nadv student.

runs.name: both_frozen_nadv
runs.title: Latent split: both, neutral-target, frozen generator
runs.description: Adversarial network with a neutral-VA target (it learns the real VA from h_neu; the student is pulled so the network reads h_neu as neutral), weight 0.1, plus the neutral-FLAME pull (cosine + L2). Generator frozen, only the split head and the adversarial network learn.

runs.name: adv_only_nadv
runs.title: Latent split: adversarial only (neutral target)
runs.description: Ablation: the neutral-target adversarial network without the pull.

runs.name: adv_only_frozen_nadv
runs.title: Latent split: adversarial only, frozen generator
runs.description: Ablation, frozen generator.

runs.name: va_both_frozen_nadv
runs.title: Latent split: VA -> latent on both (frozen, neutral-target)
runs.description: VA -> latent model on the frozen-generator neutral-target split.

runs.name: both
runs.title: Latent split: both
runs.description: Teacher: ablation 4 @100k. Neutral FLAME: gap (slow emotional drift removed except half the lip opening), anchored on the reference frame. Audio-only student with a split head after block 4 (h = h_neu + h_emo): h_neu is pulled toward the teacher's block-4 features under neutral FLAME (cosine + L2), and a adversarial network reads h_neu through gradient reversal. The method.

runs.name: va_both
runs.title: Latent split: VA -> latent on both
runs.description: On the frozen 'both' student: a causal VA -> latent model writes the emotion part (block 4 = h_neu + h_emo_G(VA)), trained with the diffusion loss only.

runs.name: plain
runs.title: Latent split: plain
runs.description: Baseline: the same audio student, no split losses (split head present, untrained).

runs.name: cos_only
runs.title: Latent split: cosine only
runs.description: Ablation: the neutral-FLAME pull (cosine + L2) without the adversarial network.

runs.name: det_only
runs.title: Latent split: adversarial only
runs.description: Ablation: the adversarial network without the neutral-FLAME pull.

runs.name: va_cos_only
runs.title: Latent split: VA -> latent on cosine only
runs.description: VA -> latent model on the frozen cosine-only student.

runs.name: va_det_only
runs.title: Latent split: VA -> latent on adversarial only
runs.description: VA -> latent model on the frozen adversarial network-only student.

runs.name: both_frozen
runs.title: Latent split: both, frozen generator
runs.description: Comparison: the generator stays frozen, only the split head (decomposer) and the adversarial network learn.

runs.name: cos_only_frozen
runs.title: Latent split: cosine only, frozen generator
runs.description: Frozen generator, pull without the adversarial network.

runs.name: flame_v3_abl2b_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 2b
runs.description: As ablation 2, but the 75 % share removes a growing top fraction of one FLAME parameter's most-moving points: 10 % at 25k, +10 % every ~6.1k steps, all points from 80k. Mouth + jaw is removed on the other 25 %.

runs.name: flame_v3_abl4_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 4
runs.description: Only the mouth + jaw is masked, on 25 % of samples; the other 75 % train unmasked.

runs.name: flame_v3_abl2_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 2
runs.description: Masked consistency: mouth + jaw removed on 25 % of samples, otherwise the top-300 moving points of one of 55 FLAME parameters (expressions 1-50, jaw, eyelids). Resumed 2026-11-06 from 170k to 500k (checkpoints every 50k).

runs.name: flame_v3_abl2_prep50k_afcrop
runs.title: Ablation 2, 50k audio-free prep
runs.description: Ablation 2's recipe after a 50k landmark-only (audio-free) prep instead of 25k, to 125k. Evaluated at 50k, 100k, 125k.

runs.name: flame_v3_noflame_afcrop
runs.title: 25k prep, then no FLAME
runs.description: The normal 25k landmark-only prep, then audio-only training with no FLAME input at all (FLAME dropped on every sample, no masks), to 100k. Scored audio-only at 50k, 75k, 100k.

runs.name: flame_v3_nocondprep_afcrop
runs.title: No-condition prep, then audio only (control)
runs.description: Control for the 25k FLAME prep: the same schedule as '25k prep, then no FLAME' but the first 25k steps get no condition at all (no audio, no FLAME); then audio only to 100k. Scored audio-only at 50k, 75k, 100k.

runs.name: flame_v3_trunk_s43_afcrop
runs.title: Seed 2: FLAME-only prep (25k)
runs.description: Second training seed (43) of the 25k landmark-only prep, for the FLAME-prep recipe.

runs.name: flame_v3_noflame_s43_afcrop
runs.title: Seed 2: 25k prep, then no FLAME
runs.description: Second seed of '25k prep, then no FLAME' (audio only after the prep). Checkpoints every 5k; audio-only evals at 50k, 75k, 85k, 90k, 95k, 100k.

runs.name: flame_v3_nocondprep_s43_afcrop
runs.title: Seed 2: no-condition prep, then audio only
runs.description: Second seed of the control (no condition 0-25k, then audio only). Checkpoints every 5k; audio-only evals at 50k, 75k, 85k, 90k, 95k, 100k.

runs.name: flame_v3_small_trunk_afcrop
runs.title: Small model: FLAME-only prep (25k)
runs.description: Smaller flow transformer (6 blocks x 768 instead of 8 x 1024), 25k landmark-only prep with the FLAME-prep recipe. Starts after the second-seed runs.

runs.name: flame_v3_small_afcrop
runs.title: Small model: FLAME branch deleted, audio only
runs.description: The small model after its prep with the FLAME branch removed (its constant audio-only output folded into a bias, exact), trained audio only to 100k. Checkpoints every 5k; audio-only evals at 50k, 75k, 85k, 90k, 95k, 100k.

runs.name: flame_v3_bx_trunk_afcrop
runs.title: FLAME block cross-attention: FLAME-only prep (25k)
runs.description: Every transformer block gets its own FLAME cross-attention before the audio cross-attention; FLAME is no longer mixed into the audio condition. 25k landmark-only prep, full size.

runs.name: flame_v3_bx_noflame_afcrop
runs.title: FLAME block cross-attention: then audio only
runs.description: The block cross-attention model after its prep, trained audio only to 100k (FLAME dropped). Checkpoints every 5k; audio-only evals at 50k, 75k, 85k, 90k, 95k, 100k.

runs.name: flame_v3_bx_trunk50k_afcrop
runs.title: FLAME-to-audio handover: FLAME-only prep to 50k
runs.description: The block FLAME cross-attention model's FLAME-only prep, continued from 25k to 50k. FLAME-driven evals at 40k, 45k, 50k to see whether it saturates.

runs.name: flame_v3_handover_afcrop
runs.title: FLAME-to-audio handover: switch 50-75k, audio only to 150k (stopped at 100k)
runs.description: The FLAME cross-attention's input slides from FLAME to an audio adapter (trained with FLAME as teacher) between 50k and 75k; audio only from 75k to 150k. Audio-only evals at 75k, 100k, 125k, 135k, 140k, 145k, 150k. Stopped at ~102.5k (100k audio-only LSE-C 6.02 < 6.5, the rule set before the run); the 100k checkpoint is kept.

runs.name: flame_v3_jointflame_afcrop
runs.title: Joint motion + 61 FLAME parameters (D59c, D59-v2 compact)
runs.description: From scratch: one model generates each frame's motion latent and its 61 FLAME parameters together, each with its own noise level. FLAME clean (a condition) to 50k, generated more and more 50k-75k, always generated after; audio throughout. FLAME-driven evals at 25k-50k (50k gate: LSE-C >= 6.9, FVD <= 125), audio-only at 75k-150k.

runs.name: flame_v3_a2fdiff_afcrop
runs.title: Audio-to-FLAME diffusion + FLAME renderer (D59-v2) (stopped at ~69k)
runs.description: From scratch: a small diffusion model learns to generate the FLAME embedding from audio while the main model learns to render from FLAME plus audio. Between 50k and 75k the main model's FLAME input slides from real to generated FLAME; generated only to 150k. FLAME-driven evals at 25k, 50k, 150k; audio-only (generated FLAME) at 50k-150k. Stopped at ~69k on 11-10 to make room for D60; resumable from its 50k state (before the switch).

runs.name: flame_v3_flametarget_afcrop
runs.title: FLAME from input to target prep (D60)
runs.description: From scratch. Prep without audio: FLAME given on every frame to 15k, thinned to keyframes and then to nothing by 50k, while a small head keeps predicting every frame's FLAME (FLAME as a target). Audio starts at 50k with the motion prior frozen until 75k; everything trains to 150k. FLAME-driven eval at 15k; audio-only evals at 75k-150k.

runs.name: flame_v3_audioprep_afcrop
runs.title: Baseline: audio from step 0, no prep (D61)
runs.description: The missing baseline for the FLAME-prep comparison: same model, data and schedule as the FLAME-prep and no-condition-prep runs, but audio from the first step and no prep stage. Queued behind D60. Audio-only evals at 50k, 75k, 100k (100k with three sampling seeds).
